parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increased DEPTH from 4 to 6, resulting in val_bpb 1.0159 (vs 1.0456). The increased capacity seems to help convergence even within the 5-minute budget. Next, I will try to optimize the learning rate for this deeper architecture, testing MATRIX_LR=0.07.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and slightly lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to optimize the larger model capacity.
